title: 基本操作｜queue：用 list 加 head 自己做
question:
佇列（queue）是「先進先出」：就像排隊買飲料，先排的人先買到。
這一題先不用 deque，用 list 自己做出佇列，支援三種指令：
1 x：x 排到最後面（push）
2：最前面的離開（pop）；如果是空的，輸出 Empty!
3：輸出最前面的數字（front）；如果是空的，輸出 Empty!
提示：新來的用 append 加到 list 最後面；另外用一個整數變數 head 記「最前面是哪一格」（一開始是 0）。pop 就把 head 加 1（不用真的把它刪掉）；最前面的數字是 a[head]；head 等於 len(a) 就是空的。
想想看：如果 pop 用 a.pop(0) 真的刪掉第一個，後面的每一個都要往前搬一格，人很多的時候會很慢。
第一行輸入 N，接下來 N 行每行一個指令。每個要輸出的結果各輸出一行。

test_case.note: 先排的 10 先離開，所以第二次 front 是 20

en.title: Basics | queue: a list and head
en.question:
A queue is "first in, first out", like a line for drinks: the first person in line buys first.
In this one, do not use deque yet. Build a queue from a list, with three commands:
1 x: x joins the back (push)
2: the front one leaves (pop). If it is empty, output Empty!
3: output the front number (front). If it is empty, output Empty!
Tip: append new ones to the end of the list, and keep a whole-number variable head for the front place (it starts at 0). pop: add 1 to head (no need to really delete it). The front number is a[head]. head equals len(a) means empty.
Think: if pop used a.pop(0) to really delete the first one, every item after it would move up one place. That is slow with many people.
The first line is N. Then N lines, one command each. Output each result on its own line.

test_case.note: 10 came first and leaves first, so the second front is 20
